parrafo_1.en: Rena Lash Beauty is a one-artist lash and brow studio in Homestead run by Mirelys Montoto. Every appointment is one-on-one: no rotating staff, no rushed timeslots, just her hands on your lashes and brows from start to finish.

parrafo_2.es: Los resultados hablan en Booksy: calificación de 5.0 en 20 reseñas, y el trabajo del día a día publicado en Instagram @rena_lashbeauty para que lo veas antes de reservar.
parrafo_2.en: The results speak on Booksy: a 5.0 rating across 20 reviews, and the day-to-day work posted on Instagram @rena_lashbeauty for anyone to see before booking.

She took the time to map my brows, listened to exactly what I wanted, and patiently explained my natural brow shape before getting started. She kept my brows nice and thick while giving them a beautiful, clean shape. I’m so happy with the results and will definitely be coming back! Highly recommend.
Un trabajo impecable y como siempre muy profesional. Me encantaron mis pestañas!!!
